summary:
we made a game wich is about a journey from the moon back home. This game has also 3 separate games in it, each one helping you grow your vocabulary  and also win the entire game.
By making our project, we developed new computer skills and learned how to make online games. 
In the end I can say that our project is important, because it helps us learn new things about space and helps us grow our vocabulary.
details: Our project is about a game in wich you have to help two people get home from the moon.
